unit.why: A narrative about the naming of R. Meir (of Przemyślany/Mogielnica? — the 'Maran') at his circumcision by his grandfather the Maggid of Kozienice, with the Berdichever's instruction overriding, plus his later use of the anecdote in a divorce case.

stories.start_quote: והנה בעת הכנסו בבריתו של אאע"ה
stories.end_quote: אשר הי׳ נשכח שם המגרש מקטנותו
stories.summary_en: At the boy's circumcision his grandfather the Maggid named him Jeremiah, but the father reported the Berdichever's order to name him Meir, so the Maggid renamed him, yet for years still called him Jeremiah, seeing him as Jeremiah's reincarnation; the rebbe told this himself when a divorce came before him where the husband's childhood name had been forgotten.
